hazard: Lack of VTE assessment for stroke patient
theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Francoise Snape
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: No VTE assessment was ever made of Mrs Snape. The explanation given oy was that staff were too busy to complete the form and that because she had had a stroke heparin could not be given and therefore the Paperwork was unnecessary
concerns.hazard: lack of VTE assessment for stroke patient

concerns.quote: NICE guidelines regarding the use of mechanical anti DVT devices instead of heparin in high risk cases was not considered
absence of a formally completed VTE assessment and lack of knowledge of NICE guidelines amounted to a lost opportunity to make informed decisions for the care of Mrs Snape
concerns.hazard: missed opportunity for appropriate VTE risk management

reports.title: Vauna Leeming: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: i. Ward managers and Matrons, in their daily safety huddles and team meetings, are reinforcing the direction that staff must sign prescription charts.
promises.summary: Ward managers to reinforce signing of prescription charts in daily huddles.

promises.quote: ii. To update and re-circulate the lesson of the week Trust-wide on mechanical thromboprophylaxis and the importance of signing prescriptions
promises.summary: Trust-wide update on mechanical thromboprophylaxis importance.

promises.quote: iii. The CMO will write to the digital team creating the electronic medical prescribing charts, formally requesting that they ensure that the new charts meet all requirements, prior to being launched (e.g. prescribing of TEDS)
promises.summary: CMO requests digital team ensure new charts meet requirements before launch.

promises.quote: ii. Therefore, each division will undertake local regular audits, to check compliance with signing prescription charts
promises.summary: Divisions to undertake regular audits of prescription chart signing compliance.

promises.quote: iii. Divisions will provide monthly VTE compliance reports to the Improving Safety Action Group (ISAG)
promises.summary: Divisions to provide monthly VTE compliance reports to ISAG.
